args.query:
-- Explore the database structure to find tables related to studies
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;

-- Examine the studies table structure
PRAGMA table_info(studies);

-- Examine shared_export table structure
PRAGMA table_info(shared_export);

-- View all studies to understand the data and find active ones
SELECT study_id, title, status, owner, start_date, notes FROM studies;

-- Get only active studies
SELECT study_id, title, status, owner, start_date, notes FROM studies WHERE status = 'active';

-- First, let's check if there are any existing entries in shared_export
SELECT * FROM shared_export;

-- Verify the entry was added correctly
SELECT * FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org = 'oversight-office' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
